QuestInfo.name: Stranger's Identity
QuestInfo.1: The stranger I met in the #m10003004# was, surprisingly, a ghost! She's been in the hospital all this time--unaware that she'd died, waiting for Dr. Niora to return... Now, unwilling to accept her death, she needs me to defeat #b50 #o21#s#k and collect #b25 #t4000020##k to bring her back to life. I really wonder if that's all it takes...
QuestInfo.2: #p412#, whom I met in the #m10003004# was a ghost. She was staying in the Hospital, not knowing that she was dead. She couldn't be revived with the #t4000020#. It seemed, deep down, that she already knew that, though... I really hope she finds peace.

0.0: Ah... this may be a little cracked, but I can definitely see myself with it.
0.1: Thank you so much. I need to get out of here as soon as I get these bandages off. It's waaay too cold in here.
0.2: What the...! No way! What... What happened here?? Why can't I see myself in the mirror? Did I... DIE?????? No way, that can't be true! I can't be dead yet! Hey there, please help me out once more!

yes.0: When you defeat #r#o21#s#k, they drop something called a #b#t4000020##k, and from what I've heard, it has the power to revive the dead. Please #rdefeat 50 #o21#s#k and bring me #b25 #t4000020##k! If I can get them, I might be able to come back from the dead...

no.0: How can you be so cold! I'll be cursing you for the rest of eternity!

1.0: Ahh, thanks for getting me the charms. I can't believe you got me all that... Well, I have to be honest with you. Even with those charms, I don't think I'll be coming back to life.
1.1: Even if I come back alive with these charms, I won't be fully alive, per se, kind of like a zombie. I can't believe it took me this long to come to terms with it... but I will never forget the fact that you took great lengths to help me out. Thank you so, so much.

yes.0: Do you like the cape that I gave you? It's a cape made of the devastating powers of the #t4000020#. I'll see you... around... somewhere... somehow...

item.0: You still didn't get #b25 #t4000020##k? Please hurry... It's so cold here.

mob.0: Don't forget, you also need to #rdefeat 50 #o21#s#k...
